points.reached by: bus_req_i ==> tx_fifo.wdata carries bus_req_i.data to the transmit FIFO write-data logic.
points.reason: The bus data is directly placed into the FIFO word, so an altered bus write can corrupt the payload.

points.reached by: bus_req_i --> tx_fifo.we supplies the write-decision inputs for the FIFO.
points.reason: The unchecked bus strobe, direction and address decide whether a payload is written, allowing a write to be injected, omitted or misdirected.

points.reached by: bus_access ==> tx_fifo.clear carries ctrl.enable to the FIFO clear logic.
points.reason: Deasserting ctrl.enable asserts the FIFO clear signal and can discard queued payload data.

points.reached by: tx_fifo.wdata ==> data_buffer carries the payload into the FIFO, and data_buffer ==> serial_engine returns tx_fifo.rdata.
points.reason: The FIFO stores bus data and returns it through tx_fifo.rdata; under the another-IP black-box rule its write data and clear input can corrupt, remove or withhold the queued payload.

points.reached by: serial_engine --> tx_fifo.re decides the FIFO read operation that releases a queued payload.
